title: Herbal Energizing Meat Russian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, juicy Russian beef stew infused with herbs and featuring redcurrants to boost energy and satisfy your appetite.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef, redcurrants, parsley, dill, lemon juice, olive oil, ginger powder, black pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Remove the beef mixture from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the beef broth and red wine (if using) to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the seared beef to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Skim any excess fat from the surface and serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
